correctness.rationale: Each forward orbit of a finite total functional Kripke frame has a unique lasso signature (t,p). The root-following map from source lasso (T,P) onto target (t,p) is a surjective bounded morphism exactly when t<=T and p divides P; pullback of arbitrary valuations establishes validity-inclusion sufficiency. Conversely, for a target world whose (t,p) is not dominated by any source world, colour its t+p distinct orbit points with distinct complete binary words using ceil(log2|V|) propositional letters. With L=max_source(t+p)<=|W|, the formula Theta=AND_(i=0..L) Box^i chi_(orbit-index-i) is true at the target and impossible at a source root: source recurrence at indices T,T+P<=L forces equal colour codes, which implies t<=T,p|P, a contradiction. Thus NOT Theta has depth<=|W| and separates. Maximal signature antichains exactly classify theories and every finite nonempty one is realized by a disjoint union of lassos. Source tail of n worlds ending in a fixed point vs cycle of n+1 worlds have identical valuation words for depths<n, while Box^(n-1)p ↔ Box^n p distinguishes at depth n. Inspected the all-size argument and the finite checker; finite enumeration is corroborative, not a proof for arbitrary frames. Logic is plain basic one-agent modal logic; no universal modality.
